title: Juicy Sweet Peruvian Chicken Dumplings
description: Savor a sweet and juicy Peruvian-inspired chicken dumpling dish, finished with a creamy cashew sour cream for a dairyfree twist.
instructions: In a bowl, mix the chickpea flour, salt, cumin, and coriander. Add warm water gradually, stirring until a soft dough forms. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes, then cover and let it rest for 10 minutes.

While the dough rests, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté the diced chicken until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Stir in lime zest, lime juice, and half the cilantro; season with salt to taste. Remove from heat and let the mixture cool slightly.

Roll the rested dough into 1‑inch rounds. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of chicken mixture onto each dough round, fold over, and crimp the edges to seal. Place the dumplings into a steamer basket or a steamer pot.

Steam the dumplings over simmering vegetable stock for 15 minutes, or until the dough is tender and the filling is heated through. While steaming, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and lightly toast the remaining cilantro until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Serve the dumplings hot, drizzled with cashew sour cream and a sprinkle of toasted cilantro. Offer a squeeze of fresh lime on the side for extra brightness.
